summary: Iteration 24 verification — 15/15 backend pytest cases PASS (100%) and all frontend fluid-budget wire-up verified live on demo user. BUG-P0 scan/food: (a) LLM returns unknown food ('zorplok curry xyz') → safety_tier='UNVERIFIED', primary_risk_factor='NONE', portion_limit_text starts with 'Not in our verified database yet', matched_food_id=None; (b) _extract_json monkey-patched to None → same UNVERIFIED response; (c) DB-match regression with 'Apple' → matched_food_id set, safety_tier in {GREEN,YELLOW,RED}. BUG-P0 scan/barcode: (a) OFF response with empty nutriments dict → safety_tier='UNVERIFIED', matched_food_id=None, and db.foods.find_one({'id':'bc_<barcode>'}) returns None (no synthetic doc); (b) OFF with valid K/P/Na/proteins serving values → safety_tier derived (RED here, K=180 + Na=250 → sodium risk), matched_food_id='bc_<barcode>' and doc created with source='barcode'. FLUID BUDGET: /api/meal-logs/summary and /api/reports/weekly both return limits.fluid_ml>0; stage=dialysis → 1000, stage=pre_dialysis → 2000; PATCH /api/auth/profile with doctor_limits.fluid_ml=1500 → summary returns 1500 (cleanup verified). FRONTEND (390x844, demo@renal.app): /meal-log renders 4th NutrientBar testID='budget-fluid' showing 'Fluid 0/2000 ml'; /report renders testID='avg-fluid' after meals are logged; /settings shows testID='settings-limit-fluid', saving 1500 persists (verified via /api/auth/me returning doctor_limits.fluid_ml=1500) and reload keeps input at '1500'. REGRESSION: /api/foods, /api/foods/food-apple, /api/foods/food-toor-dal, /api/auth/me, /api/ai/ask all 200; no non-beverage food has fluid_ml>0.
